map.：棉织物活性染料深色，推荐蒸化 8~12 min（中值 10 min）、102~: For dark shades with reactive dyes on cotton, the recommendation is 8-12 min (midpoint 10 min) of saturated steam at 102-104°C. If measured fixation is light, first check whether the steam is saturated and the humidity adequate rather than simply extending the time.
map.主要受染料类别、纤维、色泽深浅与蒸汽条件影响；深色比浅色需更久，分散/酸性常需较: The main factors are dye class, fibre, shade depth and steam conditions. Dark shades need longer than light ones, and disperse or acid dyes usually need hotter dry steam rather than saturated steam.
map.深浅色时间差多少？: How much longer do dark shades take?
map.同染料下深色通常比浅色长 2~5 min，具体以推荐区间为准，过久可能导致渗化或: With the same dye, dark shades usually run 2-5 min longer than light ones. Follow the recommended range, since going too long can cause bleeding or a poorer hand feel.
map.染料与纤维不匹配会怎样？: What happens when dye and fibre do not match?
map.如涤纶用了需还原蒸化的染料而条件不符固色失败；工具会识别纤维/染料不匹配并提示核: For example, a polyester ground with a dye that needs reduction steaming fails to fix when the conditions do not match. The tool detects fibre and dye mismatches and prompts you to check the process system.
